resources.string: Keep every distracting app under its daily limit until the day ends.
Verified by your phone\'s usage data. Pays at the end of the day if every limit held.
Couldn\'t read your usage. Try again in a moment.
To show how long you spend in each app, AWAKEN needs usage access. It reads app times on this phone only. Nothing is sent anywhere, and no app is ever blocked.
On the next screen, find AWAKEN and turn on \"Permit usage access\".
Usage access is on, but this phone reported no app usage for today. Limits aren\'t checked and no XP is paid until it does.
Limits are not tracked right now, so nothing is at stake and no XP is paid today. Grant usage access to track them.
Limits are not tracked right now: this phone isn\'t reporting app usage, so nothing is at stake and no XP is paid until it does.
Grey is all screen time, red the distracting part.
Usage stays on this phone. It never leaves the device and never changes XP by itself.
Set daily limits on distracting apps. Stay under them all day and earn +%1$d XP. Cross one and you forfeit it. Nothing you\'ve earned is ever taken.
Screen Discipline starts tomorrow. Today\'s usage is tracked but nothing is at stake yet.
No distracting app has a limit, so nothing is at stake. Set one below.
Every limit holds. Keep it until the day ends to claim +%1$d XP.
A limit was crossed. Today\'s stake is forfeited. Your earned XP is untouched. Tomorrow is a new day.
Starts tomorrow. Popular social and video apps start as distracting with a 30 min limit. Change any app below.
Tap an app to change its category or limit. Changes apply from tomorrow.
Applies from tomorrow, so today\'s limits stay fair.
A warning when a distracting app is close to its limit, and a notice if a limit is crossed.
